name: Manufacturer / Packer Details
requirement: Name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer must be declared.
passCondition: A manufacturer/packer name with a reasonably complete address is found on the label.
reviewCondition: A name or address fragment is found, but it looks too short to be a full address.
failCondition: No manufacturer, packer, or address text is found anywhere on the label.

name: Country of Origin
requirement: If imported, the country of origin must be declared.
passCondition: The label declares a country of origin (e.g. "Made in Vietnam").
reviewCondition: It's unclear from the label whether the product is imported or domestic.
naCondition: The label clearly indicates a domestic (Made in India) product, so this declaration is not mandatory.

name: Generic / Common Name
requirement: The common or generic name of the commodity must be declared, distinct from the brand name.
passCondition: A generic/common name (e.g. "Wheat Biscuits") is found separate from the brand name.
reviewCondition: This is the hardest field to auto-detect confidently — if it isn't clearly matched, it's always sent for officer confirmation rather than guessed.

name: Net Quantity (SI Units)
requirement: Net quantity must be declared in standard SI units (g, kg, ml, L, N, etc.).
passCondition: A number followed by a recognized SI unit (g, kg, ml, L, N, pcs) is found.
failCondition: No quantity + unit pair could be found anywhere on the label.

name: Manufacture / Packing Date
requirement: Month and year of manufacture or packing must be declared.
passCondition: A date is found near a "Mfg", "Mfd", "Packed on", or "Pkd" label.
failCondition: No manufacture or packing date could be located.

name: Best Before / Use By Date
requirement: Expiry or validity period must be declared for perishable/food categories.
passCondition: A date is found near "Best Before", "Use By", "Expiry", or "Valid Until".
failCondition: The category is perishable but no expiry-type date is found.
naCondition: The selected product category is non-perishable, so this declaration doesn't apply.

name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
requirement: MRP in INR must be declared.
passCondition: An MRP value in ₹/Rs. is found on the label.
failCondition: No rupee value resembling an MRP is found.

name: MRP Tax-Inclusive Indication
requirement: Label must indicate MRP is inclusive of all taxes.
passCondition: Wording like "inclusive of all taxes" is found near the MRP.
reviewCondition: MRP is present but the tax-inclusive phrase isn't confidently detected — may be present in small print.
naCondition: No MRP was found at all, so the tax clause can't be evaluated.

name: Consumer Care / Grievance Redressal
requirement: At least one consumer complaint contact (phone, email, or address) must be declared.
passCondition: A phone number, email, or "consumer care" section is found on the label.
failCondition: No contact information for consumer complaints is found.
